visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The scene opens with a high-angle close-up of a paper bag filled with straight-cut French fries, heavily seasoned with a white, powdery coating. A vibrant yellow and green text overlay is centered on the screen. (2) A young man with short black hair, wearing a black long-sleeved shirt, is seen walking through a brightly lit indoor shopping mall corridor. He looks towards the camera while gesturing with his hands. (3) The camera shifts to a close-up of the man as he puts a single fry into his mouth and chews, looking thoughtful. (4) The shot pans to show the green and yellow 'Potato Corner' logo above a clean, modern food counter with various seasoning buckets visible in the background. (5) A graphic poster is displayed showing the brand's global reach, mentioning '2000' stores across several countries with national flags. (6) The man stands before the store counter, pointing towards the menu and the automated frying machines (AutoFry) that are made of stainless steel and actively cooking. (7) A menu board is shown with various flavor options like Sour Cream and BBQ, accompanied by green mascot illustrations. (8) The man tastes the curly fries and popcorn chicken from the same brand, nodding his head and showing an approving facial expression with wide eyes. (9) He is finally seen standing next to another man in a white t-shirt, giving a thumbs-up to the camera as they stand in the middle of the mall environment.
